name: 編輯內容儲存與精簡收合版面
definitionOfDone: Content save action is visible in editable review and published meetings
Pending change count and saved/synchronizing status are explicit
Batch saves reuse per-part version checks and stop on failure without losing input
Sharing remains independent and does not auto-save with content
Sharing and history collapse and empty spacing is reduced
Production original content, access, revisions and task data remain unchanged by verification
